item.title: How Grace, Freedom and Consequences Work Together in God’s Plan
item.description: Explore the profound connection between a toddler's first steps and the profound spiritual journey of walking in God's grace and freedom. Discover how understanding grace, freedom, and consequences can guide you to make responsible choices that lead to a blessed life.

item.title: What True Kindness Really Means
item.description: Discover the surprising truth that genuine kindness, like Jesus demonstrated, sometimes means speaking hard truths rather than offering superficial comfort. This article explores how confronting issues directly and acting with love can be the most compassionate path, even when it's not the easiest.

item.title: A Prayer When You Fail Yourself - Your Daily Prayer - February 25
item.description: You will fail yourself. The real question is what you believe about yourself afterward. Discover the hope that holds you steady when shame tries to write your story.
